summary: LRE cold codegen: 15 files, build clean, 51/51 requirements traced. 7 judgement calls flagged.

issues.title: Sensor safe-large-distance default is unspecified
issues.raw: LRE-DM5 requires odist/hdist/vdist to return 'a safe large distance' when no obstacle exists but gives no value.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm 1000.0 m is an acceptable no-obstacle distance, or supply the intended value for Sensor.SAFE_LARGE_DIST.

issues.title: CPA division guarded by an invented epsilon
issues.raw: LRE-OP5 specifies cda/tcpa but not the zero-relative-velocity case, where tcpa = -(r.v)/|v|^2 divides by zero.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm flooring the squared relative speed at 1e-6 (Sensor.relSpeedSq) is acceptable, or state the intended tcpa/cda when the obstacle closes at zero relative speed.

issues.title: CAM entry action is unspecified
issues.raw: LRE-FR4 says the AUV 'performs evasive manoeuvres' in CAM, but LRE-DM7 allows only advVel/advHdng and no requirement states either value for CAM.
issues.fix_directive: Specify the advised velocity and/or heading the LRE must issue on entering CAM. No entry action was invented.

issues.title: Operator-requested transitions given priority over autonomous ones
issues.raw: The requirements state no relative priority between the unconditional operator transitions (Beh6, Beh7, Beh12, Beh15, Beh17) and the guarded autonomous ones (Beh5, Beh8-Beh11, Beh13, Beh14, Beh16, Beh18).
issues.fix_directive: Confirm that reqOCM/endTask/reqHCM take precedence within a mode; the alternative (safety guards first) would shadow Beh6/Beh15/Beh17, which are stated unconditionally.

issues.title: cstc/cdyn read from the Sensor selection functions inside each operation
issues.raw: LRE-OP2 says CheckOPEZ 'uses the index computed by CalcCStc' and LRE-OP5 says CalcCPA uses cdyn. compute() bodies may not contain local variables or calls on other operation objects, so both re-read sensor.closestStaticIndex()/closestDynamicIndex() -- the same functions CalcCStc/CalcCDyn wrap, so the values coincide within a step.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm this is acceptable, or specify an operation-to-operation wiring that keeps compute() bodies to direct this.field = expression assignments.

issues.title: Literal 1.0 thresholds in LRE-Beh4 and LRE-Beh9/Beh11 not lifted to constants
issues.raw: LRE-DM4 declares exactly four constants. Beh4 (vel <= 1, odist > 1) and Beh9/Beh11 (hvel/vvel >= 1 m/s) use numeric 1 that is not one of those four.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm these are fixed literals, or add named constants for them to LRE-DM4.

issues.title: cstc/cdyn are Java int but extracted as RoboChart nat
issues.raw: LRE-Var5/Var6 call cstc/cdyn natural numbers whose -1 value means 'no obstacle'. Java int maps to RoboChart nat, so -1 is not representable in the extracted model.
issues.fix_directive: No controller guard tests the sentinel: the Sensor returns safe defaults for index -1, per LRE-DM5. Confirm the sentinel is intended to stay inside the Sensor layer.

next_step: Run the pipeline; no issue above blocks model extraction.
